envelope.description: codeReviewMaterial: atoms and relations from a dimension's grounding

body.title: codeReviewMaterial: atoms and relations from a dimension's grounding
body.summary: Add codeReviewMaterial(grounding) in src/workflow/review-pipeline/adapters/code-review-material.ts: one whole atom per ChangedSymbolSummary in grounding order (id entityId, label file#name, file, module = the file's directory or '.', text = the row's JSON); 'calls' relations by name either direction (a name matching several rows relates to each, no self-relation, an unmatched name gives none); 'same-file' and 'same-module' relations; obligations empty and context absent. A duplicate entityId throws, naming it and both labels. Pure and deterministic.
acceptanceChecks: Every row of the grounding is exactly one atom with the specified id, label, file, module and text.
Calls, same-file and same-module relations follow the contract, including same-named rows, self-calls, unmatched names and diff-review rows.
A duplicate entityId raises an error naming it; the same grounding always gives identical material.

tests.name: src/workflow/review-pipeline/__tests__/code-review-material.test.ts: 'each included summary is one atom with id entityId, label file#name, the file's directory as module, and text equal to the row's JSON'

src/workflow/review-pipeline/__tests__/code-review-material.test.ts: 'a callee or caller name matching a changed symbol gives a calls relation; a same-named pair relates to both; no self-relation; an unmatched name gives none'
src/workflow/review-pipeline/__tests__/code-review-material.test.ts: 'same-file and same-module relations join atoms sharing a file or directory; a diff review gets same-module relations only'
src/workflow/review-pipeline/__tests__/code-review-material.test.ts: 'a duplicate entityId throws an error naming it'
src/workflow/review-pipeline/__tests__/code-review-material.test.ts: 'the same grounding gives identical material and identical neighbour summaries every time'
